articles.title: Marcus Nowicki, 82, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Marcus Nowicki for the many years of service to Foundry Row.
body: Marcus Nowicki died in November at home on Wren Street, at the age of 82. Born in Foundry Row in the years after the war, Marcus Nowicki spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Foundry Row. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Millrace Library branch in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting.
Please keep the free tax clinic in the budget. Many of us on Cherry Place use it every week.
Vera Salazar, Mill Hill
